decisions.decision: DATABASE DESIGN GATE CONFIRMED, with one change: ship idx_supercharger_history_account_updated (account_id, updated_at) now.
decisions.why: Owner chose certainty over a later slow-query investigation. The design had recommended no index; both positions are recorded in design.md's Index Plan.

decisions.decision: The new index ships in a TELEMETRY migration (task 1a.0), not the charging one.
decisions.why: It is on telemetry.supercharger_history. A module may only alter its own tables (ai/architecture.md section 2).

decisions.decision: Waves 1a (telemetry) and 1b (charging) run SERIALLY, not in parallel. 1a first, then 1b.
decisions.why: sqlc generate rewrites EVERY module's generated code in one pass, so a parallel worker would write outside its sandbox and could race a half-written query.sql. The waves are not file-disjoint.

decisions.decision: Wave 1a is SPLIT: dispatch only 1a.0-1a.2 now; 1a.3-1a.7 wait for the 5-hour reset.
decisions.why: Bucket at 85% with a 90% threshold. Owner chose a cheap slice over waiting or risking a cut-off mid-wave.

decisions.decision: The Step 5.7 suite ask is DEFERRED to the end of the full wave 1a, not made after this slice.
